selector.rationale: The presence of multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on the face, trunk, and extremities, along with the development of thickened, brown, corrugated plaques and palmoplantar hyperkeratosis, are highly suggestive of AEI. The genetic testing revealing a heterozygous variation in KRT1 also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence in the vignette to support this diagnosis, and the presence of more specific findings for AEI.
